QuestInfo.name: Also From Blake's Biggest Fan
QuestInfo.0: The autograph event is about to start, but Blake is nowhere in sight. Enin wants to get him more gifts while she's waiting.
QuestInfo.1: Enin wants to get Jr. Pepe Keychains in case Blake doesn't like Yetis. She's covering all her bases...
QuestInfo.2: You got more Jr. Pepe Keychains for Enin. Blake better love these things.
